byteward.title: Corvid announces its new RV-90 GPU
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: Corvid announced the RV-90 on Monday, its new flagship graphics card for desktop PCs.] [f02: The card is built on Nocturne, Corvid's new graphics architecture.]
[f03: It ships with 24 GB of GDDR7 memory.] [f05: The chip is made on a 3 nm process.]
[f04: Corvid says the RV-90 is twice as fast as last year's RV-80 at ray tracing.] That's a big claim, and independent testing will show whether it holds up.

launch-desk.title: Corvid launches the RV-90 graphics card
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f01: Corvid has launched the RV-90, its new flagship graphics card.] [f06: The card will cost $899.] [f07: It goes on sale December 10.]
[f02: Under the hood is Nocturne, the company's new graphics architecture.] [f03: The card carries 24 GB of GDDR7 memory.] [f04: Corvid claims the RV-90 doubles the RV-80's ray-tracing performance.]

frametime.title: Corvid's new RV-90 GPU revealed
frametime.author: Wren Halloway
body: [f01: Corvid revealed the RV-90 today, its new flagship graphics card.] Here's how it performs.
[f08: At 4K, the RV-90 ran 38% faster than the RV-80 in our testing.] [f09: Across our ray-traced games, it averaged 142 frames per second at 1440p.]
[f10: Our power meter showed the card drawing 320 W under load.] [f03: Its 24 GB of GDDR7 memory leaves plenty of headroom at high resolutions.]

ohm-and-bit.title: Corvid unveils its next-generation RV-90 GPU
ohm-and-bit.author: Imogen Vale
body: [f01: Corvid unveiled the RV-90 on Monday, its new flagship graphics card.] [f02: The card uses Corvid's new Nocturne architecture.] [f05: Corvid makes the chip on a 3 nm process.]
[f06: Corvid has set the price at $899.] [f07: Cards arrive in stores on December 10.]
[f08: In our benchmarks, it was 38 percent faster than the RV-80 at 4K.] [f10: We measured 320 W of power draw under load.]

Those numbers come with trade-offs. [f11: Corvid recommends an 850 W power supply for the card.] [f12: Under sustained load, the GPU ran at 84 °C.] [f13: At launch, only 14 games support the card's frame generation feature.]
